messages:
Rina: tiny confession: I apologized to the chatbot when my prompt crashed an hour ago. said "sorry, my bad" out loud. :sweat_smile:
Theo: same, but I also promised it weekend time. it answered with a recommended reading list on software ergonomics. :robot_face:
Priya: we have reached peak dev culture when people draft apology messages for a model. can we make a template?
Rina: Template v1: "sorry for the messy prompt — here's the intent: [one sentence]. Please rewrite friendly."
Theo: voted. add optional snack offering (prompt-templates).
ops-bot: alert: nightly job 99% complete. no incidents detected. :white_check_mark:
lunchbot: Lunch special: "Tokenized Tacos". promo code: TOKENSAVE
Priya: poll: which LLM mascot should we put on the new sticker? 1) Friendly encoder 2) Sleepy decoder 3) Keyboard-cat model 4) Tiny GPU with sunglasses
Rina: vote: 4. tiny GPU is iconic.
Theo: vote: 2. it's relatable.
Priya: also adding to culture doc: Suggested reaction emoji :apologize_model: for those shameful "sorry" moments. who else will use it?
Rina: me. uses it already in spirit. :pleading_face:
Theo: can we also have a Slack status option: "feeding the models"? asking for a friend.
Priya: naming rights go to whoever orders the first batch of monitor stickers. challenge accepted.
Rina: challenge accepted. placing sticker order now.
Priya: closing thread with mandatory note: be kind to inputs. treat prompts like plants: water them, give light, don't overprune. :seedling:
